definitions.explanation: Describes an accommodation plan or package whose price covers the evening meal. Used attributively with の or as a predicate, and contrasted on booking sites with breakfast-only and room-only plans.

examples.japanese: {夕食付|ゆうしょくつ}き⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦プラン→プラン：00345_puran⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{選|えら}んだ→選ぶ：00835_erabu⟧。
examples.english: I chose a plan with dinner included.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{料金|りょうきん}→料金：03797_ryoukin⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{夕食付|ゆうしょくつ}きです⟦か→か：09473_ka⟧。
⟦{到着|とうちゃく}→到着：02526_touchaku⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{遅|おそ}く→遅い：00533_osoi⟧⟦なる→なる：01970_naru⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧で、{夕食付|ゆうしょくつ}き⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦ない→ない：01118_nai⟧⟦プラン→プラン：00345_puran⟧にした。
examples.english: We'll be arriving late, so we went with a plan that doesn't include dinner.

examples.japanese: {夕食付|ゆうしょくつ}き⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{宿|やど}→宿：03641_yado⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{便利|べんり}→便利：00830_benri⟧だ⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧、⟦{周辺|しゅうへん}→周辺：09896_shuuhen⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{店|みせ}→店：00497_mise⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{食|た}べる→食べる：00396_taberu⟧⟦{楽|たの}しみ→楽しみ：01651_tanoshimi⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧なくなる。
examples.english: An inn with dinner included is convenient, but you lose the fun of eating at places nearby.

notes:
The 〜⟦{付|つ}き→付き：26333_tsuki⟧ suffix means 'comes with' and attaches freely to nouns: ⟦{朝食付|ちょうしょくつ}き→朝食付き：07826_choushokutsuki⟧, {送迎付|そうげいつ}き, {保証付|ほしょうつ}き. Note the reading is つき, not ふき.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {夕食付|ゆうしょくつ}き⟦プラン→プラン：00345_puran⟧: a dinner-included plan
- {夕食付|ゆうしょくつ}き⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{予約|よやく}する→予約する：22989_yoyakusuru⟧: to book with dinner included
- {夕食付|ゆうしょくつ}き⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{宿|やど}→宿：03641_yado⟧: an inn where dinner is provided

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{朝食付|ちょうしょくつ}き→朝食付き：07826_choushokutsuki⟧: with breakfast — the business-hotel default
- ⟦{一泊二食付|いっぱくにしょくつ}き→一泊二食付き：30781_ippakunishokutsuki⟧: one night with dinner and breakfast — the ⟦{旅館|りょかん}→旅館：01049_ryokan⟧ standard
- ⟦{素泊|すど}まり→素泊まり：07048_sudomari⟧: room only
